name: Dan Sullivan
summary:
Daniel Scott Sullivan (born November 13, 1964) is an American politician, attorney, and Marine Corps veteran serving as the junior United States senator from Alaska, a seat he has held since 2015. A member of the Republican Party, he served from 2010 to 2013 as commissioner of the Alaska Department of Natural Resources and from 2009 to 2010 as attorney general of Alaska.
Sullivan grew up in a suburb of Cleveland, Ohio, and graduated from Culver Academies in Indiana.
